1.explanation:
1. src/js/components/DataFilters/DataFilters.js – this is where DataFilters currently chooses between rendering inline content vs. dropContent when drop=true. It needs to be extended to handle layer=true by wrapping the DataForm content in a <Layer> instead of a <DropButton>.
2. src/js/components/DataFilters/propTypes.js – the DataFiltersPropTypes must include the new layer boolean prop so PropTypes validation is aware of it.
3. src/js/components/DataFilters/index.d.ts – the TypeScript definition of DataFiltersProps must be updated to include layer?: boolean so consumers get proper typings.
4. src/js/components/DataFilters/__tests__/DataFilters-test.tsx – tests should be added or updated to cover the new layer mode (snapshot/render tests) to ensure the new layer prop works as expected and guards against regressions.
1.bug_scenario: The user wants a new “layer” mode for DataFilters so that filters appear in a full‐width Layer overlay (as shown in the first screenshot) rather than being confined to a narrow DropButton dropdown (which in the second screenshot causes the list of filters to overflow and require scrolling). Instead of using the existing drop prop to render filters inside a small dropContent panel, a layer prop should render the same DataForm content inside a <Layer> to give ample space.
